global.title: Trump feds use a solar review to approve the first AI data center on public land
global.summary: Apparently, a 19-megawatt (MW) solar farm and a 167-MW AI data center are “substantially the same” – at least according to the Trump administration’s Bureau of Land Management (BLM).
